card.name: Time words before "during" treatment
card.fires_on: A time-related word such as time, intervals, periodically or times that comes right before "during". It appears in label text about when something happens or is checked over a course of treatment or a procedure.

modes.label: At some time
modes.description: The word "time" after "at some", before "during" treatment or therapy.
modes.example: occurred in about 2% of approximately 5,700 patients at some<< time>> during diclofenac treatment (ALT

modes.label: Repeated checks
modes.description: Words for repeated timing, such as intervals, periodically or times per week, before "during" a procedure or administration.
modes.example: Visually inspect the prepared solution, the infusion set, and catheter for precipitates, prior to administration as well as<< periodically>> during the administration.

card.writes: It promotes "during" and "throughout" (also in Chinese and Spanish), so the next word is likely to be one that marks a span of time.
card.plain: It marks a word about timing or frequency that is about to be followed by "during" a treatment or procedure.
